description: Switches the Hyperliquid account to a Unified Account with the trading key (Hyperliquid agentSetAbstraction): no wallet signature. Required for new copies at prudent, equilibre and risque, and for xyz markets at every level. Call it right after confirm_trading_key. Returns { mode, unified }; an account already unified is left as is. Errors: key_required (confirm the trading key first), switch_failed (switch it in your Hyperliquid settings).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key (1 to 255 printable ASCII characters, for example a UUID): retrying with the same key and arguments within 24 hours returns the first answer and runs nothing again.

name: switch_to_unified_account
title: Switch to a Unified Account
